title: SWF audio tags: DefineSound & StartSound
description: Extend the SWF compiler (packages/swf) to emit audio tags for SoundItem library assets and SoundLinkage keyframe events. DefineSound (tag 14) stores the audio data. StartSound (tag 15) triggers playback on a frame. SoundStreamHead2 (tag 45) + SoundStreamBlock (tag 19) for Stream sync sounds. Only touches packages/swf/. See docs/10-sound.md and docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
